title: Shop
one_line: Featured banner, four tabs, rarity-sorted product grid. Built to the approved v2 prototype.
also_read: UI_BIBLE/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 7 (layout, rarity ladder, catalogue) and the v2 prototype: live page https://claude.ai/artifact/RX1J4Pwn7D8F6CTUhL7Yvf, source UI_BIBLE/prototypes/shop_v2/index.html. Every layout, rarity effect and animation timing is in that file - read it, do not re-invent them.
gaps: Ground is slate #252D37. Must be bg_menu_emboss.
The top bar has no pill backgrounds - the numbers float on the ground.
Every product ribbon is red. Ribbons take the rarity colour (bible 5.16).
Two greens in use: the #00C38A price pill and the #2DA830 SAVE. One green only: #2DA830.
No featured banner, no rarity sections, no restore-purchases link.

anatomy.spec: Per shell-chrome. The missing pill backgrounds are fixed there, once, for every hub.

Swipeable banner carousel, 408 x 150, with dots under it: DAILY DEAL (-40 percent sale tag), STARTER PACK (5x value), NX CLUB. Each opens paywall-offer. The Starter Pack banner disappears once bought.
SHOP, straddling the panel's top edge.
Folder tabs, four, maximum allowed (bible 5.10): DICE / TOKENS / EMOJIS / ENERGY.

Section labels split each tab by rarity, LOWEST FIRST so value climbs as you scroll: COMMON, RARE, EPIC, LEGENDARY. In the shop the hairlines are replaced by the category's item icon on each side (bible 5.5) - a die on both sides of DICE.

Product cards 112 x 158, 3 per row, 10 pt gaps - exactly the 356 pt panel content width (bible 5.17). Small-card chassis, rim 6, rivets. Item render in the top 60 percent, rarity glow behind it (rays for legendary), rarity ribbon at 61 percent, price button straddling the bottom edge.
'Restore purchases' as an underlined caption at the bottom of EVERY tab. Apple requires it reachable for non-consumables, and it must also be in Settings.

states: For sale - price button. Coin prices show [coin] 1,200. Real-money prices show the store's localised string from the RevenueCat package - NEVER a hard-coded dollar amount.
Owned - green tick disc, EQUIP button.
Equipped - option amber outline on the card, no button.
Locked - disabled price with the unlock rule visible.
Loading - 3 to 5 skeleton cards that shimmer (bible 5.23). Never a blank panel.
Offerings failed to load - an error state with a RETRY, not an empty grid.
Purchase in flight - the price button goes to its loading state, spinner replacing the label, width unchanged.
motion: Featured: auto-advance every 5 s, pause on touch.
Tab change: content cross-fades 120 ms, cards stagger in at 30 ms.
Purchase and equip effects: exactly as timed in the v2 prototype source.
data: Catalogue and prices: RevenueCat offerings (T-B3). Localised strings from the package, always.
Ownership and equipped state: server-owned after T-A3. No local grants.
Rarity ladder: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 7.2. Decision D6 says the starter catalogue.

do_not: Do not hard-code a price. Real-money prices come from the RevenueCat package as the store's localised string.
Do not make every ribbon red - the ribbon takes the item's rarity colour.
Do not use a second green. #2DA830 only.
Do not exceed four folder tabs.
Do not build a separate inventory screen - the YOUR SET wells on the pre-match cards open the matching shop tab, and that is the locker.
Do not re-invent the layout or the animation timings. They are in UI_BIBLE/prototypes/shop_v2/index.html.
acceptance: Three cards fit a row exactly at the 356 pt content width with no horizontal scroll.
Each rarity's cards are visibly different by rim, glow and ribbon colour.
Restore purchases is reachable from every tab and from Settings.
A real-money price renders from the RevenueCat offering, localised.
Loading shows skeleton cards; a failed offering shows a RETRY, not a blank grid.
Ground matches Home side by side.
steps: 1. Preflight. Read UI_BIBLE/prototypes/shop_v2/index.html fully before writing any layout code.
2. Swap the ground and pick up the fixed shell-chrome top bar.
3. Build the featured banner carousel with dots and auto-advance.
4. Build the four folder tabs and the rarity section labels with item-flanked hairlines.
5. Build the product card to bible 5.17 with the four states and rarity treatments.
6. Wire the grid to the RevenueCat offerings; localised prices only.
7. Add the restore-purchases link to every tab.
8. Add the loading, error and purchase-in-flight states.
9. Port the purchase and equip effects at the prototype's exact timings.
10. Capture each tab, plus loading and error. Postflight.
prompt:
Rebuild the Ludo NX Shop as a hub, following the approved v2 prototype.

Read, in order: SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, UI_BIBLE/LUDO_NX_UI_BIBLE.md sections 6.3, 5.17 and 5.16, UI_BIBLE/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 7, and UI_BIBLE/prototypes/shop_v2/index.html. That prototype file carries every layout decision, rarity effect and animation timing - read it before writing layout code, and do not re-invent any of it. Then read this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

Structure: bg_menu_emboss ground, top bar, a swipeable featured banner (DAILY DEAL / STARTER PACK / NX CLUB) with dots, a SHOP nameplate, four folder tabs (DICE / TOKENS / EMOJIS / ENERGY), and inside each tab a grid split by rarity lowest-first, so value climbs as you scroll. Cards are 112 x 158, three per row, which is exactly the 356 pt panel content width. 'Restore purchases' sits at the bottom of every tab.

Five things are wrong today: the ground is slate instead of bg_menu_emboss; the top-bar pills have no backgrounds so the numbers float; every ribbon is red instead of the item's rarity colour; two different greens are in use (#00C38A and #2DA830 - keep only #2DA830); and there is no featured banner, no rarity sections and no restore link.

The rule that will get the app rejected if you break it: real-money prices come from the RevenueCat package as the store's LOCALISED string. Never hard-code a dollar amount.

Also build the states nobody remembers: skeleton cards while loading, a RETRY when offerings fail, and a spinner in the price button during a purchase.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
